comparison_scope: Actual field-by-field comparison of each public target record to its restricted capture: SSH exit, start/finish time, copied-pin digest equality, every history metadata field published, and installer artifact metadata when published. No raw path, network identifier, command line, or stdout is published.
limit: Integrity equality verifies the public projection only. It does not create a new installation, registration, listing, workload, exit, or claim adjudication.
